prompt: A presentation sheet of EIGHT app icons arranged in a perfectly even grid of 4 columns and 2 rows on one seamless pure white background, wide equal gaps, every object centred in its own invisible cell at the same size. Each icon is a small realistic 3D object rendered like a premium product photo: front view at eye level with only a slight turn, soft studio lighting from the upper left, soft contact shadow, matte and satin materials (paper, ceramic, brushed metal, soft-touch plastic), no glossy plastic, no cartoon. Colourful but calm and harmonised: each object has its own main colour from this palette - deep ink blue #1F2F5C, cobalt blue #2F5BD3, emerald green #1E8C6A, warm amber #E3A33B, violet #6B4FD8, coral #E06A4E - combined with white and light grey. Same lighting, same camera, same material quality for all eight so they clearly belong to one set, like the 3D icon sets of modern fintech apps (Revolut). No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no faces. The eight objects, left to right, top row then bottom row: 1) an upload tray with a white sheet of paper and a cobalt-blue arrow pointing up out of it; 2) an emerald-green speech bubble with a white question mark shape cut out of it (shape only, not a letter); 3) a white certificate document with a violet wax-style seal; 4) an amber desk calendar standing upright; 5) a small ink-blue house; 6) an ink-blue document folder with papers peeking out; 7) two overlapping chat bubbles, one coral one white; 8) a simple person bust figure in cobalt blue (abstract, no face).
